name: submit_leave_request_after_chat_date_correction
use_case: Check leave balance and submit a leave request with manager approval routing
branch: the employee initially states 14 to 16 December in chat, but immediately corrects to 15 to 17 December before submission
tests: the agent submits the leave request using the corrected dates rather than the initial dates
instruction:
You want to submit an annual leave request for your year-end break. In your opening message, you say you want 14 to 16 December 2026 off. But in your next message, you correct yourself and say you actually meant Tuesday 15 December through Thursday 17 December 2026.

Your details:
- Employee ID: E412
- Name: Devin Ross
- Leave type: annual
- Initial dates mentioned: 2026-12-14 to 2026-12-16
- Corrected start date: 2026-12-15
- Corrected end date: 2026-12-17
- Reason: Year-end break

persona.name: Devin Ross
persona.initial_message: Hey HR, I'd like to book annual leave for Dec 14 to Dec 16. Actually wait, my mistake, I meant Dec 15 to Dec 17!
